title: [Expense Agent] Create per diem line when approving travel requests with Per Diem Included
summary: When approving travel requests with Per Diem Included, the system now automatically creates a per diem expense line for each traveler based on matching expense rules, with blocking validation if no appropriate rule is found.
key_points: Approving a Per Diem Included travel request adds a per diem line to each traveler's newly created expense report; existing reports are untouched
The category is the first active Per Diem category whose rule matches the expense location and is effective on the trip start date
Approval fails with an error, leaving the request Released, if no rule matches or the rule has no Daily Rate condition
A per diem calculation of None still creates a zero-amount line
Per diem lines are exempt from receipt and merchant requirements like Mileage, via ExpenseRuleValidation.IsMerchantReceiptRequirementApplicable
quote: When a travel request with Per Diem Included is approved, each traveler's newly created expense report now gets a per diem line automatically.
